podcast.body: An album that rebooted Quincy Jones's discography, described by All Music as the album that "kickstarted Jones's career as a recording artist." It recast his big band influences within the framework of the budding fusion movement, incorporating elements of contemporary rock, pop, and R&B. The LP rode the charts deep into 1970, peaking at number 56. "All music calls Walking in Space the album that, quote, kickstarted Jones's career as a recording artist, recasting his big band influences within the framework of the budding fusion movement. And the influences of contemporary rock, pop, and r&b, unquote."
